UP man converts to Islam for love, now returns to Hinduism

Ayush Malik, a resident of Uttar Pradesh, converted to Islam in 2019 after marrying his Muslim girlfriend. He had been performing Islamic prayers and observing Islamic customs. Recently, he has returned to his Hindu faith after the breakup with his wife. The decision comes amid concerns about the conversion process and its implications on personal freedom and social harmony.
